rationale: Single predetermined low-cost ablation: EMA half-life equals one 2Hz observation interval. May reduce transient premature evidence but can delay already-late predictions.
current_prompt_policy: Unchanged B0 Current0.8/K2, seven ordered positions
selection: No parameter sweep or validation fitting. Research-only comparison; never automatically promotes a model.
acceptance: Paired-seed recall must improve without increasing paired false/min or changing Prompt timing. Report lost as well as recovered events. Independent recordings still required.
evaluation: Frozen complete100, eight development recordings, exact-edge one-to-one [boundary-1.5,boundary). No backdating, no expanded window, no test arrays.
